title: OSAC Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for Open Sovereign AI Cloud deployment

cliImage.description: Default OpenShift CLI image used by hook jobs

dbInit.description: Shared PostgreSQL host for the db-init hook

kafka.description: Kafka cluster coordinates for per-instance topic/user creation

replicas.description: Kafka broker replica count (drives topic replication factor)

aap.description: AAP connection settings for the operator

statusPollInterval.description: Interval for polling AAP job status

tokenFile.description: Path to service account token file

controllers.description: Enable or disable individual operator controllers

networkingProvisioning.description: Dispatch AAP jobs to provision networking resources. Set false for Kind dev (no fabric): controllers reconcile VirtualNetwork/Subnet/SecurityGroup to READY without provisioning.

configSecret.description: Optional Secret with additional operator configuration

optional.description: Allow the Secret to be absent without failing the deployment

hubAccess.description: Hub access ClusterRole for the operator subchart

enabled.description: Create hub-access ClusterRole (exported for fulfillment-service to bind)

externalHostname.description: Hostname for the external API Route

internalHostname.description: Hostname for the internal API Route

name.description: Name of the cert-manager ClusterIssuer or Issuer

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing the CA bundle

issuerUrl.description: OIDC issuer URL (e.g. Keycloak realm URL)

idp.description: Identity provider configuration for user management

credentials.description: Credential volume sources for IdP access

connection.description: Database connection volume sources (secret or configMap references)

log.description: Logging configuration for the fulfillment service

namespace.description: Parent namespace path within the Vault-compatible store

kvMountPath.description: KV v2 secret engine mount path within tenant namespaces

lifecycleRole.description: Vault role name for JWT authentication during lifecycle operations

lifecycleMountPath.description: Auth method mount path in the Vault parent namespace for lifecycle JWT authentication

keycloakClientId.description: Keycloak client identifier for Vault authentication

keycloakIssuerUrl.description: Keycloak OIDC issuer URL for configuring JWT auth in tenant Vault namespaces

keycloakAudience.description: Expected audience claim in Keycloak JWTs for Vault JWT auth role configuration

caBundle.description: Trusted CA certificates bundle for TLS connections to the Vault-compatible secret store

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing trusted CA certificates in PEM format under the key 'bundle.pem'. When empty, the shared CA pool is used.

credentials.description: Volume sources for the Keycloak client secret used for Vault authentication

enabled.description: Create AAP instance CR (set false if AAP is managed externally)

noLog.description: Suppress sensitive data in AAP logs

routeTlsTerminationMechanism.description: TLS termination mechanism for AAP routes

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for AAP pods

enabled.description: Run AAP bootstrap job after install

cliImage.description: OpenShift CLI image used by the bootstrap job's init containers (wait-for-admin-secret, wait-for-aap)

backoffLimit.description: Number of retries for bootstrap job

readinessConsecutiveSuccesses.description: Number of consecutive successful AAP readiness checks required before the bootstrap Job proceeds

manifestSecret.description: Secret name for config-as-code manifest instance group

secret.description: Secret name for config-as-code instance group

projectGitUri.description: Git repository URI for config-as-code project

importAgentsEnabled.description: Enable ConfigMap-based bare metal agent import. Sets OSAC_IMPORT_AGENTS_ENABLED=true in the config-as-code-ig Secret and gates the import-agents-inventory ConfigMap.

importBcmAgentsEnabled.description: Enable BCM inventory backend. Sets OSAC_IMPORT_BCM_AGENTS_ENABLED=true in the config-as-code-ig Secret and gates the bcm-certs Secret.

importAgents.description: Server inventory for bare metal agent import. Enable via aap.configAsCode.importAgentsEnabled.

servers.description: Server inventory for bare metal agent import. Each entry provisions a BareMetalHost CR.

name.description: Server hostname, used as the BareMetalHost CR name

bmc_url.description: Redfish BMC address for virtual media boot

bmc_username.description: BMC username. The playbook creates a Kubernetes Secret named {name}-bmc-secret with these credentials.

bmc_password.description: BMC password. The playbook creates a Kubernetes Secret named {name}-bmc-secret with these credentials.

netris_server_name.description: Netris server name label for the Agent

resource_class.description: Hardware type label for the Agent

disable_bmc_cert_verification.description: Per-server override for BMC TLS certificate verification

importBcmAgents.description: BCM mTLS client credentials. Enable via aap.configAsCode.importBcmAgentsEnabled.

cert.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for BCM mTLS authentication

key.description: PEM-encoded client private key for BCM mTLS authentication

clusterFulfillment.description: ConfigMap and Secret for the AAP cluster-fulfillment instance group

config.description: Environment variables for the cluster-fulfillment instance group

DNS_CLASS.description: Fully-qualified Ansible role name of the DNS driver

DNS_ZONE.description: DNS zone to operate in (defaults to EXTERNAL_ACCESS_BASE_DOMAIN)

NETRIS_RESOURCE_CLASS_MAP.description: JSON mapping of resource classes to Netris server labels

SERVER_SSH_BASTION_HOST.description: SSH bastion host for server access

SERVER_SSH_USER.description: SSH user for direct server access

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_BASE_DOMAIN.description: Base domain for external access DNS records

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_SUPPORTED_BASE_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated list of supported base domains

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_API_INTERNAL_NETWORK.description: Internal network CIDR for API access

HOSTED_CLUSTER_CONTROLLER_AVAILABILITY_P.description: Availability policy for hosted cluster control plane

HOSTED_CLUSTER_INFRASTRUCTURE_AVAILABILI.description: Availability policy for hosted cluster infrastructure

PARKING_VNET_NAME.description: Name of the parking V-Net where idle CaaS agents sit before cluster assignment (effective default: idle-agents-network)

IMPORT_AGENTS_NAMESPACE.description: Namespace for BareMetalHost, Agent, and InfraEnv CRs (effective default: hardware-inventory)

IMPORT_AGENTS_INFRAENV_NAME.description: InfraEnv CR name for agent discovery (effective default: infraenv)

IMPORT_AGENTS_PULL_SECRET_NAME.description: Pull secret name for InfraEnv discovery ISO (effective default: pull-secret)

IMPORT_AGENTS_DISABLE_BMC_CERT_VERIFICAT.description: Default BMC TLS certificate verification skip (effective default: true)

BCM_API_URL.description: BCM head node API endpoint (e.g., https://bcm-head:8081)

BCM_VALIDATE_CERTS.description: Verify BCM TLS certificates (effective default: true)

BCM_DISABLE_BMC_CERT_VERIFICATION.description: Skip BMC TLS certificate verification during BCM system discovery (effective default: false)

secret.description: Secret values for the cluster-fulfillment instance group

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key for Route 53 DNS backend

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret key for Route 53 DNS backend

SERVER_SSH_KEY.description: SSH private key for server access

SERVER_SSH_BASTION_KEY.description: SSH private key for bastion access

networkFulfillment.description: ConfigMap and Secret for the AAP network-fulfillment instance group

config.description: Environment variables for the network-fulfillment instance group

secret.description: Secret values for the network-fulfillment instance group

storageFulfillment.description: ConfigMap and Secret for the AAP storage-operations instance group

config.description: Environment variables for the storage-operations instance group

secret.description: Secret values for the storage-operations instance group

publishTemplates.description: Configuration for AAP template publishing instance group

OSAC_TEMPLATE_COLLECTIONS.description: Comma-separated list of Ansible collections containing OSAC templates

OSAC_FULFILLMENT_SERVICE_URI.description: Internal URI for the fulfillment service

enabled.description: Deploy the OSAC UI web console

externalHostname.description: Hostname for the OpenShift Route (auto-assigned if empty)

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing the CA bundle for the fulfillment API

oidcClientId.description: OIDC client ID for the UI

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing the CA bundle for auth

connection.description: Database connection volume sources (secret or configMap references)

csiBackends.description: Vendor CSI backend configuration (deployed with csiDriver)

bmfCrds.description: Bare Metal Fulfillment Operator CRDs configuration

enabled.description: Enable or disable the BMF operator subchart

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the operator

name.description: Override the ServiceAccount name (uses fullname if empty)

secrets.description: Names of Secrets mounted into the operator pod

inventoryConfig.description: Secret name for OSAC inventory configuration

managementConfig.description: Secret name for OSAC management configuration

testBackend.description: Kind/IT only: seeds a fake backend so BMF can run without real OpenStack/Ironic

enabled.description: Seed osac-inventory-config/osac-management-config pointed at the metal3 backend

namespace.description: Namespace containing the fake BareMetalHost objects (defaults to the release namespace if empty)

secretNames.description: Names for the fake inventory/management Secrets this seeds -- distinct from bmf.secrets.* on purpose, see values.yaml

configMaps.description: Names of ConfigMaps mounted into the operator pod

env.description: Environment variable overrides for the BMF operator pod

aapInsecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for AAP API calls (set to 'true' for self-signed certs)

bcm.description: BCM inventory backend configuration. When enabled, creates osac-inventory-config and osac-management-config Secrets and mounts BCM mTLS credentials.

enabled.description: Create BCM inventory and management config Secrets and mount mTLS credentials

url.description: BCM head node API endpoint (e.g. https://bcm-head:8081)

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification of BCM server certificate (test environments only)

hostClass.description: Host class identifier for BCM inventory

bmhNamespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where BareMetalHost CRs are created for Metal3 power management

cert.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for BCM mTLS authentication

key.description: PEM-encoded client private key for BCM mTLS authentication

caCert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate for verifying BCM server certificate (optional)

metal3.description: Metal3 inventory and management backend configuration. When enabled, creates osac-inventory-config and osac-management-config Secrets.

enabled.description: Create Metal3 inventory and management config Secrets

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where BareMetalHost CRs are located

hostClass.description: Host class identifier for Metal3 inventory

networkManagers.description: Network manager ConfigMaps for the osac-operator dispatcher

metallb.description: MetalLB IPAddressPool and L2Advertisement for LoadBalancer services

addressCIDR.description: CIDR range for the MetalLB address pool

hubAccess.description: Hub access SA, RBAC, and create-hub hook (CI/dev only)

enabled.description: Create hub-access resources and register local cluster as hub

bundledVault.description: Bundled OpenBao (Vault-compatible) secret store for dev/CI environments. When enabled, deploys a single-replica OpenBao instance in dev mode with emptyDir storage.

enabled.description: Deploy a bundled OpenBao instance for development/CI use

devRootToken.description: Root token for OpenBao dev mode (required when enabled)

image.description: OpenBao container image (must be 2.5+ for namespace support)

clusterVersions.description: Seed ClusterVersion records in the fulfillment-service after install

default.description: Mark as the default cluster version

lvms.description: Register LVMS as a local StorageBackend + StorageTier in the fulfillment service after install. For CI/development environments only.

enabled.description: Run the register-local-storage hook job when LVMS is deployed

networkClass.description: Create a NetworkClass in the fulfillment service after install. At least one of k8sManager/fabricManager must be set when enabled.

title.description: Human-friendly short title for the NetworkClass. Required when enabled — the fulfillment service rejects NetworkClass creation without one.

description.description: Human-friendly long description for the NetworkClass (Markdown)

k8sManager.description: k8sManager name to set on the NetworkClass (must match a manager already registered via operator.networkManagers.k8sManagers)

fabricManager.description: fabricManager name to set on the NetworkClass (must match a manager already registered via operator.networkManagers.fabricManagers)

isDefault.description: Mark this as the default NetworkClass used when a VirtualNetwork doesn't specify one

defaults.description: Tenant-onboarding defaults. Required for this NetworkClass to auto-create a default VirtualNetwork/Subnet/SecurityGroup for new tenants.

virtualNetworkIPv4CIDR.description: IPv4 CIDR for the auto-created tenant VirtualNetwork (e.g. 10.200.0.0/16)

subnetIPv4CIDR.description: IPv4 CIDR for the auto-created tenant Subnet (e.g. 10.200.0.0/20)

enableNatGateway.description: Auto-create a NATGateway for the tenant's default VirtualNetwork

egressRules.description: Default egress rules for the auto-created tenant SecurityGroup
